title: RunConfig
description: Operator-supplied configuration for a Run. The Initializer combines this with the Pack's Instructions Provider output to build the immutable SourcingRunContext.

instructionsPayload.description: Operator input forwarded verbatim to the Pack's Instructions Provider.

granularityPolicy.description: Operator-supplied granularity policy for the Run. Pack-typed payload (engine forwards verbatim into the frozen SourcingRunContext). Read by `GranularityKS` (Target Blackboard, TOP_DOWN) via `controlContext.runContext().granularityPolicy()` to decide whether to post `Definition.Verdict` Contributions (`keep` / `drop` / `splitInto` / `mergeWith`) consolidating identities AFTER Statement shaping. Wave 9: replaces the dropped `Granularity` panel's per-Run policy levers; the per-identity verdicts now live as a slot on `Definition`.

resolverOverrides.description: Per-panel resolver overrides keyed by panel name. `compose` performs schema-driven per-key merging of value objects (engine merge function over the resolved JSON Schema); use it for panels whose value carries independent fields contributed by multiple KSs (e.g. Statement).

externalToolBindings.description: Operator narrows the Pack's requestedExternalTools to actual host paths. Sandbox execve is restricted to these resolved bindings.

completionPredicate.description: Optional 'satisfactory solution' stop criterion. Fully-qualified Java class name (loaded from a Pack JAR) implementing the engine's CompletionPredicate interface: `boolean test(BlackboardView view, SourcingRunContext ctx)`. When it returns true, Control short-circuits the Iteration loop even before quiescence. Implementations use the same BlackboardView Java accessors as KS triggerPredicates. There is NO string DSL.
